steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Select the mapped product variant.
Verify the product variant is set correctly.
Select the required delivery location.
Verify the delivery location.
Complete the remaining mandatory pricing-sheet fields.
Open the savings configuration drawer.

steps.note: Configure savings at line-item level.

args.label: Choose column to calculate savings on

steps.note: Use Budget as the savings reference.
Enter the budget reference value of 120 for the product.
Save the budget savings configuration.
Verify the configured budget value is shown.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite two QA vendors so both specified bids can be submitted.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor bid at 90.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so the bids can be evaluated.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison view after closure.
Verify the savings amount is 300, calculated as (120 - 90) × 10.
Verify the savings percentage is 25 percent.
